name: Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 card that mentions "Spell Counter" in its effect  or 1 "Endymion" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion". During the Main Phase, if you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; give control of this card to your opponent, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use each effect of "Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion" once per turn.
